coords: Schematic coordinates, not a scan. x,y are stall centers. w is frontage along the row; h is stall depth. rotation is degrees of the +w (along-row) axis, SVG convention (positive clockwise, y-down), around the center.
method: Clean redrawn SVG schematic based on the published site plan. Building positions and angles follow the plan’s general layout (west 400s column, north 300s, diagonal 500–900 canopies, east 200s, south 100s) with even stall cells and aisles so rows never overlap. 367 numbered spaces plus two wash-bay stalls (W, B) shown as an amenity. Positions are approximate.
